note: Teams whose expected starter for some remaining games isn't the QB with the most dropbacks this season (the 'main QB'). Every entry cites reporting. 'out_rest' = main QB out for every remaining game. 'returns_week' = main QB expected back that week. 'draw' = no timeline: games missed are drawn from past absences (src/metrics/nfl_playoffs.absence_lengths), conditioned on games already missed and any minimum (IR = 4).

ARI.why: Brissett traded to Baltimore; Gardner Minshew out for the season (elbow); rookie Carson Beck starts.

BAL.why: Huntley (toe) is on injured reserve for the season; Brissett started Monday. Lamar Jackson is out 6-10 weeks after thumb surgery (per the team), so he may return late in the season. We don't model that return, so Baltimore's chances may be a little low.

LV.why: Cousins went back to Minnesota before the trade deadline; rookie Fernando Mendoza starts.

MIA.why: Willis is on injured reserve (core muscle), not season-ending; IR means at least four games.

MIN.why: Murray (hamstring) is week to week and has missed two games; Cousins starts.

NE.why: The Patriots fear Maye fractured his ankle and say he likely won't play in week 12; he could miss the rest of the season (ESPN). We assume at least 4 more games, then draw the rest from past injuries.

NYG.why: The Giants made McCarthy the starter over Winston in week 7.

NYJ.starter: Geno Smith if cleared, otherwise Cade Klubnik
NYJ.why: Smith's ankle tests didn't show anything major (NFL Network); he's questionable for week 11 and starts if cleared (coach). We assume he plays.

PHI.why: Hurts is out for the season (blood clots).

SEA.why: Darnold (quad, ribs) sat week 10 ("Sam will be another week," the coach said Nov. 9) and Seattle is off in week 11. We assume he's back in week 12.
